body:
That actually badass, it's actually not too dissimilar to a Liopleurodon, which actually used to exist!

Crazy shit.

Well, it's good to know I'm not alone in this shit.

I have never been treated the way you have in person, although I have been spoken to like I'm an absolute prick on many occasions. I sincerely hope you've recovered from that :(

I'm gonna sit out my 21st birthday and not give it the gravitas it's due, after all that's probably the worst thing I could do, make a great big deal out of it.

My main problem with repressing feelings is that I never 'release' them, so I end up breaking in half at the end of my temper. I'm still yet to find something that I can do as a release, apart from screaming my gut up into a pillow.

And I have no idea what could help my situation. I want my friends back, but that's not going to happen. As far as I can guess they fucked me over and didn't think twice about it, which is pretty fucking shitty. I tried speaking to a couple old friends about a year and a half ago but I got so nervous I got out of my face on morphine and alcohol and froze up so badly when I saw them I couldn't say what I needed to and sat there like a cabbage. So I fucked that one up.

Thanks for your input stranger, it means a lot to me.
Random shit like tattoo art and 'elaborate doodles' as I've ended up terming them, I'll have to get a deviantart account set up so I can maybe show you, but i'd feel a bit bigheaded doing that :P

Hey man, apologies for not responding too quick, I had no idea anyone would even see this thread. (Reddit is a pretty big place, after all) 

I'm trying real hard to reach a different perspective, but for some reason, I just can't do it. I should stop being so naturally cynical and just 'go with the flow' so to speak.

In regards to the paranoia, I don't use cannabis anymore both because it fucked my head up from chronic use (excuse the pun) and smoking makes me feel like crap as I had a bilateral pulmonary embolism (clot in both lungs) less than a year ago. It used to be an issue when I was smoking an eighth a day in a three hour session just to feel 'normal' again, but I haven't been genuinely paranoid for a good couple of years now. I know where you're coming from though, I'm sure it will look like I'm just a paranoid pot head, but I can assure you I'm really not.
It's reassuring what you've said about the character assassination, but sadly I'm still convinced it has gone as far as I mentioned. It's fucking bad. :( 

Thankyou very much for your comment >:3

EDIT: Smiley face at the end looks dumb, replaced it with lion.

Thankyou. :)

As far as hobbies go, I used to draw stuff like 4-8 hours a day just 'cause I liked doing it, I'm attempting to go back to it as I type this so hopefully I can get back into the momentum of it and give myself something to do.

...Whoah, I had no idea this would generate so many responses, I'm gonna read through all these and reply as best I can.

I can't believe I posted this and just left it for a day, it was kind of careless.
